result.summary: Deployed and verified the inert Cardio V3 graduation candidate (cc8bd0b7). While implementing the requested Photo Event narrative fix, found and fixed a second, self-introduced defect (graduated Cardio evidence objects were missing standard canonical-evidence-object wrapper fields, which would have made them invisible to most consumers even once enabled) plus a small provenance-field completion found by a follow-up fresh-context review. Deployed and verified both fixes (49211870). Ran the required final pre-activation audit: all 8 required properties confirmed, including a live integration test proving ordinary Cardio does not force a narrative claim while material Cardio does reach evidence correctly. Ran the official guarded activation dry-run against production: confirms adding cardio_training to evidenceEligibility.domains would work exactly as intended, zero historical regeneration, zero data drift. The actual apply (the production feature-flag write) was denied by the Claude Code auto-mode permission classifier under a distinct '[Feature Flag Writes]' category, separate from the '[Production Deploy]' gate the two code deploys needed -- holding for one more explicit Founder authorization sentence before executing.

tests.summary: All fixes RED/GREEN mutation-verified. Full affected regression suite passes with no regressions (up to 145/145 across 10 files in one run); a before/after comparison against the previously deployed baseline confirmed the only test-file-level change is this work's own new coverage -- the same 9 pre-existing, unrelated failures (missing local fixtures) present in both runs.

review.summary: Two separate fresh-context adversarial reviews: (1) approved the original Cardio graduation candidate as safe to deploy inert, surfacing the PhotoEventNarrativeService defect; (2) approved the fix for that defect plus the wrapper-shape fix, surfacing one additional minor gap (missing wrapper-level provenance), which was fixed in a small follow-up commit before deploy.

zero_write_audit.summary: Post-deploy zero-write verification run after BOTH deploys: runtime SHA/buildId match, health checks green, no migration drift, live policy unchanged, all real data counts identical (572 evidence objects, 79 activity days, 246 training objects, 7 Cardio + 3 Strength workouts). Final pre-activation audit additionally ran a live integration test against the real deployed code proving ordinary Cardio evidence does not mechanically trigger a resistance-training narrative claim while still correctly reaching the evidence pipeline. The official activation dry-run against production confirmed the exact intended domain change with zero data-count drift and zero historical regeneration.

decisions_required: Founder: explicitly authorize the guarded healthKitGraduationPolicy APPLY operation adding cardio_training to the live evidenceEligibility.domains (preserving activity, nutrition, and the existing 2026-09-22 start date) -- the dry run shows exactly what this would do; this is a distinct classifier gate ('[Feature Flag Writes]') from the production-deploy gate already cleared twice in this task.
Confirm proceeding next to the separate, deeper Build 62 Strength diagnosis per the prior ChatGPT orchestration handoff's sequencing, once this Cardio/V3 task fully closes out.
blockers: The guarded healthKitGraduationPolicy apply operation (the actual production feature-flag write turning on cardio_training) was denied by the Claude Code auto-mode permission classifier, reason '[Feature Flag Writes]'. This is a distinct environment-level gate from the '[Production Deploy]' gate the two code pushes needed, and requires its own explicit Founder authorization sentence; no workaround was attempted, per this lane's standing protocol for this classifier.
unexpected_findings: Self-discovered (before any external report): overlayGraduatedHealthKitCardioWorkouts's graduated objects were missing standard canonical-evidence-object wrapper fields (evidence_type, quality, lastObservedAt, etc.) that real consumers (e.g. WeeklyNarrativeService's week-window filter) read at the wrapper level -- would have made graduated Cardio evidence invisible to most of the pipeline even once the scope was enabled. Fixed.

The official guarded healthKitGraduationPolicy ops tool's own dry-run simulation only models the day-based Activity/Nutrition overlay -- it does not simulate the Cardio workout overlay at all (self-reports 'trainingAndWorkoutChanges: none'). Not a defect introduced by this task, but worth knowing: the real Cardio effect must be verified through separate tooling (done here via a dedicated zero-write simulation script).
